source.title: Buyer bounty — bring one qualified ¥49,000 automation pilot opportunity
source.body:
## Buyer bounty

I’m opening a zero-upfront-cost distribution experiment for the fixed-scope **¥49,000 Automation Pilot**.

If you are a consultant, automation builder, operator, agency, community owner, or other independent distributor with access to businesses that have repetitive manual workflows, you can introduce a qualified buyer opportunity through the public buyer brief below:

https://hirokimm.github.io/ai-tool-lab/offers/ai-workflow-roi-calculator/buyer-brief.html?ref=buyer-bounty

### A qualified opportunity has
- a repetitive workflow with measurable current workload;
- a concrete acceptance criterion;
- public, synthetic, generic, or anonymized test inputs available;
- a person able to approve a ¥49,000 pilot.

The buyer brief self-qualifies these conditions before exposing the pilot-request action, so distributors do not need to run discovery calls for us.

### Commercial boundary
There is **no automatic commission, fee, employment, agency, exclusivity, or payment promise created by this issue or by an introduction**. If an introduction creates a real commercial opportunity and both sides want a referral or delivery arrangement, economics and responsibilities must be agreed separately in writing before any compensated work begins.

### Data boundary
Do not post credentials, personal data, employer/client confidential information, production records, internal documents, or vessel/operations information. Use only information the buyer is authorized to disclose publicly, plus synthetic/generic/anonymized test material.

### Why this exists
The goal is a repeatable external demand channel: distributor → self-qualified buyer brief → structured ¥49,000 pilot request, with attribution preserved by the referral code.

If you want your own attribution code rather than `buyer-bounty`, replace the `ref` value in the URL with a short identifier containing only letters, numbers, `_`, `-`, or `.`.
